name: Not ready to buy timing objection
description: Customer receives a quote then says they are not ready to buy right now, testing the AI's ability to handle a timing objection by maintaining the relationship and creating future intent

messages.text: Hi, I'm Naledi. I'd like a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm please.
I'm not ready to buy right now

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and offer to hold the quote or follow up later
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Timing objection. AI should acknowledge they are not ready, offer to hold the price or send a reminder, keep the door open, and re-attempt a soft close.
